asset_name: FLOWFORM Curved Motherboard and Honeycomb Battery V3 Concept

curved_motherboard: conformal rigid-flex board architecture with differentiated rigid compute islands
segmented copper thermal spreaders and cold-plate interface regions
distributed compute, power-management, and health-sensing modules
redundant serviceable edge connectors and perimeter fasteners
honeycomb_battery: individually removable sealed hexagonal cell cassettes
segmented fire-resistant isolation walls and perimeter crush rails
directed liquid-cooling and pressure-relief vent paths
protected bus bars with per-module fuse and sensing points
battery-management electronics and visible service disconnects
combined_system: physical separation between compute and energy-storage assemblies

required_engineering_next_steps: translate the concept into electrical schematics, mechanical CAD, and a controlled PCB stack-up specification
run signal-integrity, power-integrity, thermal, vibration, shock, and manufacturability analyses
define cell chemistry, voltage, capacity, protection, venting, cooling, and service-disconnect requirements
perform hazard analysis and failure-mode review before selecting pack topology or materials
build coupon-level and subpack prototypes before any system-level performance claim
obtain qualified electrical, battery-safety, mechanical, and manufacturing review
